reporting_checklist.label: Surface
reporting_checklist.detail: Name lobe, gyrus/sulcus and cortical versus subcortical position.

reporting_checklist.label: Deep structures
reporting_checklist.detail: Check basal ganglia, thalamus, internal capsule and corpus callosum.

reporting_checklist.label: Posterior fossa
reporting_checklist.detail: Localise midbrain, pons, medulla, cerebellar hemisphere and peduncles.

reporting_checklist.label: Spaces
reporting_checklist.detail: Trace ventricles, cisterns, extra-axial spaces and midline relationships.

reporting_checklist.label: Supply
reporting_checklist.detail: Distinguish arterial territories, border zones and venous drainage without assuming fixed boundaries.
